section.31: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

31.name_native: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

hadiths.text: Qatadah narrated with his chain of narrators:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If a man emancipates a slave shared by him with another man, his emancipation rests with him (who emancipated his share). This is the version of Ibn Suwaid
